title: Improve Your Learning by Teaching

source.name: VOA Learning English — Improve Your Learning By Teaching
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: You might be looking for new ways to improve your understanding of something you are studying. Perhaps you are seeking better methods to remember important information.
One way to help you reach these goals is to try teaching – not as a job, but as a way to improve your own learning.
A 1982 study found that tutoring helped both the tutors and the people who studied with them.
Tutoring means teaching one person or a very small group of students.

More recent studies have looked at the link between teaching and memory. A 2013 study, which we briefly described in a previous Education Tips, found that teaching had a strong effect on understanding and learning.
An important part of the study compared the learning results of people who actually taught a lesson to those who simply prepared but did not teach.

“Overall, these findings suggest that when students actually teach the content of a lesson, they develop a deeper and more persistent understanding of the material than from solely preparing to teach,” the researchers wrote.
A 2018 study suggests that teaching may help your learning because you have to remember the information you have learned as you continue to teach. Experts call this “retrieval.”
The basic idea is that if you want to improve your memory of what you have learned, you have to practice remembering that information.
One way might be to teach your family or friends about something that you are learning. For example, you could teach your parents about English grammar or vocabulary.
You could also try teaching a younger person – perhaps a cousin, brother or sister. Try to make your lessons simple and clear, and ask them what they do not understand.

The process of teaching and asking for feedback will help you realize that you may not understand some things as well as you thought you did. That is an important, necessary step in the learning process.
A final idea for those who like technology: You could record video of yourself teaching information. You could then send the lesson to friends or put it on YouTube or some other social media service.

questions.q: What did the 1982 study find about tutoring?
options: The tutor and the learner both benefited from it
Only the learner gained any benefit from the lessons
Only the tutor gained any benefit from the lessons
Neither of them gained anything that could be measured
questions.explain: Đoạn 3: tutoring “helped both the tutors and the people who studied with them”.

questions.q: What did the researchers conclude from the 2013 study?
options: Teaching only helps people who work with a single learner at a time
Preparing a lesson in detail was as effective as teaching it to others
Teaching a lesson gave deeper, more lasting understanding than just preparing
Teaching helps short-term memory but has no effect on understanding
questions.explain: Đoạn 6–7: so sánh người thật sự dạy với người chỉ chuẩn bị; kết luận người dạy “develop a deeper and more persistent understanding”.

options: bringing back to mind something you have already learned
finding a book or an article in a library or on the internet
repeating a lesson to the same listener again and again
taking notes while another person is teaching a class
questions.explain: Đoạn 8–9: khi dạy bạn phải nhớ lại thông tin đã học; “to improve your memory… you have to practice remembering that information”.

questions.q: What does the writer advise when you teach a younger person?
options: Teach only topics that the child has already studied at school
Avoid asking questions so that the child does not feel nervous
Keep the lessons simple and find out what the child cannot follow
Use difficult vocabulary so that the child learns more quickly
questions.explain: Đoạn 11: “make your lessons simple and clear, and ask them what they do not understand”.

questions.q: According to the writer, what is one benefit of asking for feedback?
options: You can finish the lesson in a much shorter amount of time
You can persuade your learners to agree with everything you say
You can be sure that you will never make a mistake again
You may find gaps in your own knowledge that you had not noticed
questions.explain: Đoạn 12: dạy và xin phản hồi giúp bạn nhận ra mình “may not understand some things as well as you thought”; đó là bước cần thiết.

questions.q: What is the idea behind the suggestion about recording a video?
options: It shows other people that the speaker is an expert on the subject
It gives people who enjoy technology another way to practise teaching
It is a rule for students who would like to become teachers
It removes the need to prepare the lesson carefully in advance
questions.explain: Đoạn 13: “A final idea for those who like technology” – quay video bài giảng rồi gửi bạn bè hoặc đăng lên mạng.

questions.q: The 2013 study found that people who only prepared a lesson ended up with a deeper understanding than people who taught it.
questions.explain: Đoạn 7: ngược lại – người thật sự dạy hiểu sâu và bền hơn người chỉ chuẩn bị.

questions.q: The people who took part in the 2013 study were university students.
questions.explain: Bài không nói người tham gia nghiên cứu năm 2013 là ai.
